heroSummary: Anne Arundel County Public Schools began the 2025-2026 school year with staggered openings on Monday, August 25, 2025. Grades 1-12 opened on Tuesday, August 26, and the last scheduled student day was Wednesday, June 17, 2026.
heroSummaryFacts: Staggered ECSE, Pre-K, and Kindergarten opening
Three weather make-up days built into the end of the year
calendarNotes: The AACPS 2025-2026 calendar begins with teacher onboarding and opening activities before students arrive. Grades 1-5 and grades 6 and 9 begin on August 25, while grades 1-12 begin on August 26. ECSE, Pre-K, and Kindergarten families follow a separate conference and staggered opening schedule from August 25 through September 2. The calendar includes Project Unity two-hour early dismissal days on October 14, December 9, February 10, and March 17, with additional early dismissals at marking period and year-end points. Parent-teacher conferences close schools for all students on November 24-25. Easter/Spring Break runs March 30-April 6, and the calendar notes three make-up days at the end of the year.

calendarFaqs.q: When did AACPS start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: AACPS opened for grades 1-5 and grades 6 and 9 on Monday, August 25, 2025. Grades 1-12 opened on Tuesday, August 26, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When was AACPS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: AACPS Easter/Spring Break ran March 30-April 6, 2026, with schools and central offices closed.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last student day for AACPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar listed Wednesday, June 17, 2026 as the last day for students, with a two-hour early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: Did AACPS use staggered openings in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. ECSE, Pre-K, and Kindergarten used conferences and staggered openings from August 25 through September 2.

customSections.label: AACPS 2025-2026 Opening Sequence
customSections.content: AACPS did not use one single opening day for every student group in 2025-2026. Families with younger students needed to follow the ECSE, Pre-K, and Kindergarten staggered opening chart.
